skill.label: 色相環の分割による配色

derivationRule: Current official Grade 2 sample explicitly tests split complementary and pentad, states that achromatic colors may be used in hexad, and states that two dyads can form a tetrad. Plus Colors, supervised by a Color Certification Level 1 coordinator and citing the 2020 revised official text, explicitly fixes the retained nonvisual rules: dyad = two complementary hues / PCCS hue difference 12; split complementary = one hue plus the two neighboring hues of its complement; tetrad = four equal hue-circle divisions / adjacent hue difference 6 / two complementary pairs; PCCS pentad = triad plus white and black because 24 hues cannot be divided evenly by five; hexad = six equal divisions / hue difference 4 / three complementary pairs, with tetrad plus white and black also valid. No answer uses image appearance, RGB/HEX, monitor values, or unstated geometry.

questions.prompt: PCCSで、補色の位置にある2色を組み合わせる配色はどれですか。
questions.sentence: PCCSで、補色の位置にある2色を組み合わせる配色はどれですか。
questions.explanation: ダイアードは色相環で補色の位置にある2色の配色で、PCCSでは色相差12です。

qa.independentRecheck: re-read the explicit dyad definition as two complementary hues / PCCS difference 12 before comparing with proposedAnswer

questions.explanation: PCCSのダイアードは補色色相配色なので色相差12です。

qa.independentRecheck: independently recovered PCCS dyad hue difference 12 from the explicit source rule before comparing with proposedAnswer

questions.prompt: PCCSのテトラードで、色相環上の隣り合う採用色の色相差はいくつですか。
questions.sentence: PCCSのテトラードで、色相環上の隣り合う採用色の色相差はいくつですか。

qa.independentRecheck: used official sample F plus the explicit tetrad rule to recover two complementary pairs before comparing with proposedAnswer
